lead.headline: Claude Code Projects turns a goal into parallel cloud coding threads
lead.summary: Anthropic's redesigned Projects (beta in Claude Code) adds a coordinator chat that scopes a goal, spins up parallel threads — each a full Claude Code cloud session on its own git branch — runs tests, opens PRs, and reports back. Shared project memory builds over time; you can steer from your phone and work continues after you step away. Rolling out this week to more Pro and Max cloud-session users; local threads and Team/Enterprise come later.

number_of_day.label: Claude Haiku 5.5 input price per million tokens on prompts up to 100K — now the default Haiku on the API, a tenth of Haiku 4.5 ($1). Above 100K tokens it jumps to $0.50/$2.50.

news.headline: Nadella wants an 'emergency brake' on AI models
news.summary: In a Saturday X post, Microsoft's CEO said it's time to assess AI's "trust architecture": separate the model from its harness, externalize safeguards, log every meaningful action with tamper-proof evidence, and always let an authorized person pause or shut a model mid-task — "like an emergency brake."

news.headline: Google Playground builds browser games from text prompts
news.summary: Google Labs launched an experimental US-only (18+) platform at playground.google: describe a game, tweak physics and characters in chat, then share a link or publish to a gallery. Powered by Gemini and other Google models; free with higher limits on Google One. Unity Spark (closed beta soon) will add pro-level 3D mechanics.

news.headline: Helsinki's Comparables.ai raises $6M seed for AI M&A intel
news.summary: Pragmatech and Araya led the round for the platform that maps private-company markets with data on 370M+ firms — financials, ownership, valuations, deals and contacts. Used by 50,000+ pros in 30+ countries; founders include Aalto/University of Helsinki ML researcher Muhammad Ammad-ud-din.

news.headline: Codex defaults to GPT-6.1 Sol; Claude Code patches permission bypasses
news.summary: Codex CLI 0.161 makes GPT-6.1 Sol the default in bundled and Bedrock catalogs; Daybreak now needs an explicit cli_daybreak opt-in. Claude Code 2.1.289–2.1.296 fixed Bash deny/ask rules skipped under sandbox auto-allow and a UNC-path read bypass — update to 2.1.296+ if you rely on hooks or deny rules.
